_readme: This is a reference registry, not a folder-generator input like
taxonomy.json/schemas.json. It exists so you have one place to manage
the list of independent Tippanikaras (post-Jayatirtha commentators on
Sarvamoola) instead of that information being scattered across
Workflow: when you populate a 'tippani' item in some Sarvamoola work's
data.json, its 'author' field should match a key in this file. This
file is where you record who each Tippanikara was, their approximate
period, guru-lineage, and their known works - the taxonomy itself just
This list is a starting point (the most prominent Tippanikaras) rather
than exhaustive - many more exist across the Madhwa tradition. Add
entries the same way as you come across them.

raghavendra_tirtha.notes: One of the most prolific Tippanikaras; wrote sub-commentaries across nearly the whole Sarvamoola corpus.
known_works: Tantradipika (commentary on Poorva Mimamsa related material)

vadiraja_tirtha.notes: Also composed independent Vyasakuta granthas (see vyasakuta/vadiraja_tirtha in taxonomy.json) in addition to tippanis.
known_works: Rukminisha Vijaya (kavya, not strictly a tippani)

vyasatirtha.notes: Primarily known for independent Vyasakuta granthas (Nyayamrita, Tarkatandava, etc. - see vyasakuta/vyasatirtha) as much as for direct tippanis.

satyanatha_tirtha.notes: Pontiff of Uttaradi Matha; wrote sub-commentaries in the Jayatirtha-tika tradition.

satyapramoda_tirtha.notes: Placeholder entry - add known works as confirmed.

chalari_sheshacharya.notes: Placeholder entry - add period and known works as confirmed.

raghuttama_tirtha.notes: Placeholder entry - add known works as confirmed.
